nom: CeraVe Hydrating Micellar Water & Makeup Remover for Face, Lips & Eyes

avis.texte: Does a good job, but needs to be rinsed off. Definitely has a sudsy effect and leaves residue.
I have very sensitive, combination type skin. This is the only cleansing product I have found that makes me feel like my skin is actually cleansed, without drying it out.

CeraVe Facial Moisturizing Water Review I absolutely love CeraVe Facial Moisturizing Water! It leaves my skin feeling fresh, hydrated, and soft without feeling greasy or heavy. My skin feels noticeably smoother and more refreshed after using it. It’s gentle enough for everyday use and has quickly become a favorite in my skincare routine. Definitely worth trying if you’re looking for a simple, hydrating product!

They’ve changed the packaging but this fantastic micellar water is still the same, thankfully! It’s gentle and effective for removing makeup and residue from your skin. I’m prone to breakouts and this stuff doesn’t aggravate my skin at all, in fact it makes it better. Super easy to use, I just squirt it on a cotton round.

I use this every day and it has helped my skin look and feel so much better. My skin feels refreshed and no dryness. It has helped keep my pores clean, so acne is almost nonexistent since using this regularly. Definitely recommend!

avis.texte: It removes makeup really well. It does feel a little irritating on my skin, but it definitely gets all my makeup off. I’ve been breaking out more lately, so I switched from an oil-based cleanser to a water-based one.
